Developers can reproduce the on-device experience in just a few steps. Visit our edge deployment repository for platform-specific build guides, or go to the download page to try pre-built apps ...

sources.title: GitHub - OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V: A Pocket-Sized MLLM for Ultra-Efficient ...
sources.snippet: The most notable models in the series currently include: MiniCPM-V 4.6: 🔥🔥🔥 The latest and most efficient model in the MiniCPM-V series. With a total of 1.3B parameters, it surpasses larger models like Gemma4-E2B-it in performance, while showing superior efficiency than smaller models like Qwen3.5-0.8B (achieving ~1.5x token throughput).

sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.6 | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.6 ships as two independent checkpoints — this recipe covers the Instruct model (openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.6). For chain-of-thought output, use the separate openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.6-Thinking checkpoint instead (unlike v4.5, the mode is no longer toggled at runtime).

sources.title: OpenBMB launches MiniCPM-V 4.6 1.3B Instruct - artificialanalysis.ai
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.6 1.3B Instruct is vision-language model that supports text, image, and video input with text output. OpenBMB is a China-based lab jointly founded in 2022 by Tsinghua University's NLP Lab and ModelBest Inc.
